instrument: fresh Playwright Chromium launched with headless=false against an isolated AUTOTESTER_ROOT

checks.evidence: The real /onboard page contained URL/domain fields, credential and source repeaters, evals, conditions and use cases; clicking both repeater controls produced two rows each.
A fake richly taught project submitted through the form returned 303 and rendered the canonical project detail without the submitted raw credential.
The Sources page rendered eval, condition, use-case, URL and video rows; a repeated eval appeared once and exactly the video row exposed Analyze.
Submitting the existing slug returned 400 and preserved the original project.
A project could declare a scoped SecretRef without setting a value.
A second project attempting the unset owner's key returned 400 and created no project directory.
A hostname-shaped fake credential reused as allowed_domains and credential_domains returned 400; the value was absent from the response page, response body, project tree and .env.
The fake rich-intake credential existed in the isolated root .env and nowhere in project/source JSON artifacts.
